rules.crossing_definition: Actionable weapon contact from which immediate blade-work can continue before separation; German Bind and Italian Crossing share one engine state.
rules.crossing_cleanup: At exchange end contact becomes none unless a Play explicitly retains or transforms the Crossing.
rules.pressure_source: action-or-Play only; never random, margin-, skill-, Guard-, or zone-derived
rules.durchwechseln_timing: after Cross/Beat declaration and before the Parry roll; D1 is paid with no refund; the Parry roll is skipped
